premises.text: Email consumes a large share of work and smartphone time, making it the primary mobile use case
premises.evidence_span: email is the most important thing on your smartphone. People spend 40% of their time on smartphone to deal with the emails

premises.text: Mobile email still presents desktop clutter: formats, metadata, and repeating signatures
premises.evidence_span: when you scroll down this email, you will need to go through all these frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures again and again

premises.text: Intelligent content parsing reformats email into a conversation view like text messaging
premises.evidence_span: MailTime's intelligent content parsing engine can reformat all your emails into this conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging

premises.text: In-app @mentions, task lists, and participant add/remove support email as collaborative chat
premises.evidence_span: you can also mention someone with an at symbol to assign a task

premises.text: The app warns when outbound email is too long so messages stay short enough to read
premises.evidence_span: when I'm trying to send this super long email, Mailtime just told me that it's too long, didn't read

premises.text: Email content stays between the mail server and the phone; cloud only detects inbox changes for push notifications
premises.evidence_span: we send and receive every single email just directly between your mail server and Mailtime on your phone. So we don't touch any content. with our cloud

premises.text: Free for the first email account; $0.99 to connect additional accounts
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime will be free to connect with first email account. We will charge you only $0.99 if you want to connect more email account with Mailtime

premises.text: Building on open universal email technology enables broader reach than closed messenger networks
premises.evidence_span: MailChimp is now built on top of the open and universal email technology. We believe we have better chance to reach more audience

value.text: Email redesigned for smartphones as a conversation people can actually read and act on
value.evidence_span: It's a way how we design email for your smartphone

causal_links.evidence_span: frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures
mail like what you do, like text messaging
Mailtime will be free to connect with first email account
